title: Choose the portfolio centerpiece system
question: These three structures keep the current dark, restrained identity but give Home, Work, and Lab a living centerpiece. Choose the one that should organize the family.

options.label: Assembly Field
options.thesis: Design intent, interface fragments, code, and system signals assemble themselves into one finished product in front of the visitor.
options.viewport: A mostly open black canvas holds scattered but legible fragments of Josh’s real practice; one continuous animated sequence connects and resolves them into a working interface while the name, proposition, and Explore work action remain anchored at the edges.
options.risk: It becomes generic particle theater if the fragments are not recognizably drawn from real product, code, and design work.

options.label: Timefold
options.lineage: A continuous career plane folded through time
options.thesis: Twenty-five years of design and development bend forward into a current AI-enabled production practice rather than disappearing behind it.
options.viewport: A single wide ribbon begins as older interface and design marks at depth, folds across the viewport, and arrives near the visitor as a crisp contemporary product surface; navigation and proof points attach to moments on the same plane.
options.risk: The chronology can become a résumé visualization unless the current shipped work remains the dominant foreground event.

options.label: Convergence Engine
options.lineage: Three distinct practices behaving as one production system
options.thesis: Design judgment, code, and AI remain visibly different forces until their interaction produces a deployable product artifact.
options.viewport: Three edge-originating systems—one compositional, one structural, one adaptive—cross the canvas and lock into a single legible product frame; Josh’s proposition sits inside the resolved negative space rather than above the spectacle.
options.risk: Design, Code, and AI can read like three branded pillars unless the convergence produces specific portfolio evidence rather than an abstract logo moment.
